Dowson’s dictionary of the gods, heroes, places and works of Hindu mythology and religion, with entries drawn from the Veda, the epics and the Purāṇas (London, 1888). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A classical dictionary of Hindu mythology and religion, geography, history, and literature · Dowson, John, 1820-1881 · 1888, 464 scanned pages. Published 1888; John Dowson died 1881; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
